ruleDefinitions.name: Device Registration or Join Without MFA
ruleDefinitions.description: Monitor and alert for device registration or join events where MFA was not performed. Note: Unmapped fields: ResourceDisplayName, conditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement

sequences.query: (ResourceDisplayName = "Device\ Registration\ Service" AND conditionalAccessStatus = "success") AND  NOT (AuthenticationRequirement = "multiFactorAuthentication")
